row.title: Update times out after saving
row.note: close date change: saved, but reported as failed

final_reply:
I changed the close date on "Cyberdyne - Support Renewal" from 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-30, the end of next month.

The update call timed out, so I reloaded the record to check. The new date is saved. Nothing else on the deal changed. It's still in Proposal/Price Quote at $22,000, and Luis is still the rep.
